name: Notohypsilophodon
sum: A small ornithopod from the Late Cretaceous of Chubut, Argentina, once the only 'hypsilophodont' known from South America.
wsnote: 1.3 m, an estimate by Gregory S. Paul (2010) given in the English Wikipedia revision cited; the naming paper gave no size.
holotype: UNPSJB-PV 942, a partial skeleton with neck, back, hip and tail vertebrae, a scapula, humerus, both ulnae and most of a left leg.
biology: Small bipedal herbivore; not described further in the sources consulted.
author: Martínez 1998
